invariant: Ordinary all-targets test shards complete on supported CI hosts without linking or executing libFuzzer targets, while explicit Unix fuzz runs retain their libFuzzer entry points.

original.platform: github-hosted windows-2025 MSVC and local x86_64-pc-windows-gnu
original.independent_reproducer: three detached old-revision builds with fresh Windows GNU target directories, plus one bounded fresh Linux all-targets run
original.failure_signature: Windows GNU tried to build libfuzzer-sys and failed before the package; hosted MSVC linked no-main fuzz test binaries and failed with LNK1561; Linux all-targets launched an unbounded fuzz loop

fault_schedule: compile the testing shard on Windows or run it on Unix
required_reachability: fuzz binary selected as a test target
platform-specific entry-point or dependency boundary reached
reproducer.oracle: Cargo exit status and exact dependency, linker, or bounded-timeout diagnostic
reproducer.minimization: one fuzz package, one enabled fuzz feature, and one selected fuzz binary are sufficient; omitting all-features or the binary hides the target-boundary defect

fix.root_cause: libfuzzer-sys was unconditional across operating systems and the fuzz entry modules remained active when Cargo forced binary test-harness builds

fixed_replay.expected: exit 0; all four Windows fuzz binaries link without libfuzzer-sys; the native all-targets suite exits 0; an explicit Unix fuzz run still executes libFuzzer

negative_control: cargo run --locked --package peritus-bug-discovery --bin sse --features fuzzing -- -runs=1 still enters libFuzzer and completes its bounded run
cleanup: all detached old-revision worktrees and fresh task-owned build directories are removed after evidence capture
limitations: hosted MSVC reproduction was one failing runner; three fresh independent repetitions used the Windows GNU cross target
fuzz campaigns remain hosted on Ubuntu
